summary: Retest of F11 fix (iteration 16): admin products list delete flow with inline two-step confirmation is FULLY WORKING. All 8 verification steps pass. Sheet opens with Edit + Delete + Cancel; tapping Delete swaps the row to a red 'Yes, delete permanently' row, subtitle changes to 'This cannot be undone.', cancel label becomes 'Keep product'. Tapping the red confirm row fires DELETE /api/products/{id}, closes the sheet, refreshes the list without the product. Cancel path (Keep product) closes sheet with NO DELETE call made. Regression: closing the sheet mid-confirm (backdrop click) and reopening on a different product starts in the normal Edit/Delete state (confirmingDelete reset via useEffect on menuOpen). Edit row still navigates to /admin/product/<id>. No console red-box errors. No React Native / Expo issues detected in the touched file.
critical_code_review_comments: products.tsx delete flow now correctly wires performDelete -> api('/products/{id}', { method:'DELETE', auth:true }) -> closeMenu() -> load(). Clean, idempotent state via confirmingDelete boolean; useEffect on menuOpen resets confirm state when switching products. Good pattern.

Consider using a spinner (or disabling the whole sheet) instead of just changing the confirm-row label to 'Deleting…' while the DELETE is in flight, to prevent accidental double-taps on other rows during network latency. Low priority.

context_for_next_testing_agent: F11 (delete from /admin/products list) is fixed and re-verified. Bottom-sheet flow is: tap product-more-<id> -> Edit + Delete rows -> tap product-delete-action-<id> -> row swaps to product-delete-confirm-<id> (red) with subtitle 'This cannot be undone.' and cancel label 'Keep product' -> tap confirm fires DELETE. Reset triggers: closeMenu() (backdrop, handle drag, Cancel/Keep button) AND useEffect on menuOpen change. Login: admin@garlic.app / Admin@123. Admin products route: /admin/products. Testable via network sniffing on DELETE requests to /api/products/<id> (verified 0 DELETE calls on the Keep-product path, 1 DELETE call on the confirm path).
rca_of_issue: Iteration 15's F11 bug root cause was that the delete action in the ActionSheet did not have a two-step confirmation flow; it relied on window.confirm() which Playwright auto-dismisses and provided poor UX on mobile web. Iteration 16 fix replaced window.confirm() with an inline confirm state (confirmingDelete boolean) inside the same bottom sheet, using testable testIDs (product-delete-action-<id> -> product-delete-confirm-<id>). Verified working via UI + network capture.
